title: MatchFill
description: A mod that allows to deposit all items or by filter, and sorting.
body:
A very lightweight mod that's centered around inventory management!

Features:
- Deposit all items (shift + click on the deposit button)
![Depositing all items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/e5mQIIP1/images/804967db54f41e34edcb94df54c0da9b35e37537.gif)
- Deposit only items existing in the storage (click on the deposit button)
![Depositing existing items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/e5mQIIP1/images/82f7559d2b8bc27c970ed035bfab34d191839a2b.gif)
- Sort/Order items in the storage automatically
![Sorting existing items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/e5mQIIP1/images/747bb0e26470fdcae498c2aab2ac3695106311d2.gif)

This mod should be compatible with every mod that introduces a new external storage type!
